========================================
Call-expression operand beside a signed number keeps the operator
========================================

int f(int);
int sdslen(char *);
int h(void) {
  int x = f(1) - 1;
  int y = f(1)-1;
  char *s;
  char *ep = s + sdslen(s) - 1;
  int z = f(-1);
  int w = x - 1;
  return f(1) + 1;
}
